message:
You know, when I was a kid, storms were just a reason to bundle up with hot cocoa and watch the rain dance on the windows. Now that I’m a grandparent, I find myself turning into what my family affectionately calls ‘the gloriously over-prepared person.’ I’ve learned that a little planning can make even the stormiest of days feel manageable. 

I recently stumbled upon some great guidance on how to prepare for hurricanes, which is really useful for anyone wanting to stay ahead of the game. It’s all about keeping things calm and collected—like a good game of poker, but with a flashlight and some extra batteries. 

So, what’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during a storm? 🌧️
